title: PIGEONS LOVE PIAZZA DUOMO
gallery_text: In my city, Milan, even the pigeons seem to embrace the Italian ritual: sightseeing in Piazza Duomo, then off to Sempione for aperitivo. Mapping these unlikely tourists reveals a familiar rhythm and a sight that makes me feel at home.
description:
The map brings together a CSV of pigeon sightings shared by iNaturalist users to document wildlife and a GeoJSON of square centroids published by the City of Milan to locate and identify its streets and piazzas. Neither dataset was made to tell this story: together, they offer a playful view of pigeons sharing the places and routines that make Milan feel like home to me.

Dataset:
- piccioni_milano_inaturalist.csv — geolocated observations of Columba livia in Milan, downloaded from the iNaturalist public API.
- milano_centroidi_toponimi.geojson — place-name centroids published by the City of Milan, downloaded from its Geoportal’s “Centroidi Vie” service. The map uses records classified as Piazza, Piazzale and Piazzetta.

The notebook and project files are available on https://github.com/MichelleNuccio/smt
